headline: Labcorp Holdings (LH) Draws Fresh Earnings Optimism, Is It Still 4% Undervalued?
summary: Labcorp Holdings (LH) is in focus after recent commentary highlighted rising analyst optimism ahead of its June 2026 quarter earnings, with expectations for higher revenue and year over year earnings growth. See our latest analysis for Labcorp Holdings. The Labcorp Holdings share price has gained 11.9% over the past month and 17.9% year to date.
